scope: Exact finite affine constraint compilation; parameter and group-action holdouts, not an unseen architecture family
input_contract: Finite index sets, paired permutation generators, permitted matrix entries including constant input; affinity and equivariance are supplied task obligations
prediction: Dimension equals the number of simultaneous-action orbits wholly contained in permitted entries; the coefficient basis consists of disjoint orbit indicators
compiler_contract: Build homogeneous rational linear equations for equivariance and support, solve by general row elimination, emit scalar multiply/add programs; no family names or layer templates enter the compiler
oracle_contract: Independently enumerate the finite generated permutation action and its entry orbits; compare Burnside count, support, rank and complete basis
charging: Report constraint entries, equation count, rational scalar arithmetic, active scalar coefficients, runtime multiply/adds and parameter coordinates; bit complexity and physical timing are not inferred
risk_prediction: For a fixed coefficient subspace V and mean-zero noise covariance sigma2/n times identity, risk is squared projection bias plus sigma2*dim(V)/n; selecting V after observing the same noise is outside this claim
controls: runtime trace agrees with direct matrix evaluation
exact finite noise risk equals theorem
interpretation: The cases and known group actions were chosen by informed authors. This tests prospective numerical consequences of an explicit algebraic contract, not ignorance of architectural history or empirical family superiority.
